title: ZeroTask Configuration
description: Schema for ZeroTask process orchestrator configuration files (zero.json)

$schema.description: URI of the JSON schema for validation

defaultTimeout.description: Global default timeout in milliseconds applied to tasks without explicit timeout

tasks.description: Dictionary of tasks keyed by unique task identifier

cwd.description: Working directory path relative to project root

dependsOn.description: List of task names that must successfully complete before this task starts

retries.description: Number of retry attempts with exponential backoff on task failure

timeout.description: Per-task maximum runtime in milliseconds before SIGTERM escalation

env.description: Key-value dictionary of environment variables injected into the process

color.description: Terminal output prefix color theme for this task
